title: Issues installing xdrip+ on Sony SW3
symptom: User is trying to configure a Sony SW3 to use xdrip+ but the app crashes with 'Unfortunately, xDrip+ has stopped' after installing via ADB. Other users report xDrip not appearing on the watch after setup.
fix: One user reports eventually getting it to work after a few hours/days with a method referenced in issue #1419.
evidence_quote: I eventually got it to work (took a few hours/days to show up) with this method. https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/1419
